hero.headline: Your agents are a team now
hero.sub: An agent is no longer a setting buried inside an automation. Each one has its own page, a face, a job and a soul, and automations, tasks and chats all pick from the same team.

shot.alt: The new Agents page, titled Team, with four agents of a demo project: Churn watcher, Growth analyst, Launch reviewer and Release writer. Each card shows the agent's initials, its job, the first lines of its soul, and where it works (Automations 1, Tasks 1), with an Add to team card at the end.
shot.caption: Agents gets its own page in the rail.

blocks.title: Every agent has a soul
blocks.body: The job says what an agent does. The soul says how: its stance, its tempo, its tone and what it refuses. You write it, or start from a template like careful researcher or harsh reviewer, and it is approved together with the job.

shot.alt: The Growth analyst's profile panel: Talk to it and Edit buttons, then its Soul ('You find out before you claim. Every statement rests on a source you actually read.' with rules about citing sources, saying how sure it is and never presenting an assumption as a finding), then its Job and its model, opus.

blocks.title: An automation picks who does it
blocks.body: An automation is now an agent plus a schedule plus a job. The same agent can run a Monday digest, answer you in chat and work a task, and what it learns on one run carries into the next.

shot.alt: Two automation cards: Monday metrics digest, runs as Growth analyst on Mondays, and Nightly churn check, runs as Churn watcher daily, each with its agent's initials on the left.

blocks.title: Hand a task to an agent
blocks.body: Assign a task to an agent and it starts working on it. The agent's face sits on the card, so the board shows who has what.

shot.alt: The Tasks kanban of a demo project. Annual plan on pricing page carries the LR (Launch reviewer) badge, Churn exit survey carries CW (Churn watcher), and Investigate trial-to-paid drop, in progress, carries GA (Growth analyst).

blocks.title: Modes read like a model picker
blocks.body: The chat's mode menu is one quiet list: Basic, Planner, Developer and Train Me, each with the version of its brief. Your agents sit right under the modes, so starting a chat as one of them is one click.

shot.alt: The chat mode menu: Modes lists Basic 1.0 (selected, 'Plain Claude. No mode enabled.'), Planner 1.0, Developer 1.0 and Train Me 0.1 ALPHA; below, Agents lists Churn watcher, Growth analyst, Launch reviewer and Release writer; at the bottom the permission switch, Auto or Bypass.

blocks.title: A chat can arrange its own window
lines: Drive the chat window this agent is drawn in: tabs, splits, mode, model
state    The window's panes and tabs, and which one is you
new      Open a new chat as a tab, or beside it with --split
split    Move a tab into its own pane beside its current one
join     Move a tab into another tab's pane, undoing a split
focus    Bring a tab to the front of its pane
mode     Switch a chat's mode: basic | plan | develop
model    Switch a chat's model live, from the next turn
effort   Switch a chat's effort live: low | medium | high | xhigh | max

blocks.title: dreamcontext Memory: pick how your past is recalled
blocks.body: Settings shows every recall engine with its measured accuracy in English and in mixed languages, its speed, its cost and where your data goes, then recommends one for the way you write. Cloud engines stay off until you give a key and your consent.

shot.alt: The dreamcontext Memory settings card: running now, Smart picker (Claude) at 64% accuracy; recommended for you, Fast keyword search at 88% accuracy, with a Switch to Fast keyword search button. Below, the Smart picker row shows 64% English only, 57% multi-language, +2 to 6 s, free, prompt sent to Claude.

blocks.text: Your existing agents move to the new shape on update. A teammate still on an older CLI cannot run them until they upgrade, and approving an agent or an automation now happens only on the Agents or Automations page, never from inside a Claude session.

closer.title: Meet your team
closer.body: Open Agents in the rail, add someone, give them a soul, and hand them a task.
